(#{spotType}, #{spot.columns.name}, ST_SRID(POINT(#{spot.columns.longitude}, #{spot.columns.latitude}), 4326), #{spot.columns.address}, #{spot.columns.weatherNx}, #{spot.columns.weatherNy}, 'ACTIVE', #{now}, #{now})
